blocks.text: The Stride-Count Physics Behind the 15-Foot Commercial Track-Off Rule

Walk into 80 percent of small-to-midsize US office suites (2,500 to 24,999 square feet) and you will see the exact same procurement mistake just inside the front door: a lone 3x4-foot or 3x5-foot mat floating on an expanse of VCT tile or commercial broadloom carpet. Because the average adult walking stride measures 28 to 32 inches, a person pushing open an office entry door steps onto a single 5-foot mat with their right foot and steps directly onto bare interior flooring with their left foot—or at best makes one contact per shoe. Controlled facility track-off studies cited by ISSA, BOMA, and LEED-EBOM Green Building standards confirm that a 3-to-5-foot mat captures only 25 to 33 percent of incoming shoe-borne grit and moisture.

According to ISSA commercial facility research, roughly 80 percent of all dust, sand, asphalt oils, and de-icing salts inside an office building enters on the soles of employee and visitor shoes, and deleting a single pound of accumulated dirt after it spreads across interior carpets and hard floors requires up to $500 to $600 in paid custodial labor hours ($35 to $65/hr standard rate). When you extend your entrance walk-off system to 15 linear feet (accommodating 5 to 6 full footsteps—three impacts on the left shoe and three on the right), soil and moisture capture jumps to 85 percent. Extending to 18 to 25 feet in extreme winter or high-traffic Class A towers captures over 92 percent.

blocks.title: LEED v4.1 Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ) Entryway System Standard
blocks.text: To qualify for LEED Operations and Maintenance (O+M) Indoor Environmental Quality credits—and keep interior particulate matter (PM10 and PM2.5) within ASHRAE guidelines—all primary building entrances must maintain a permanent or roll-out walk-off entryway system at least 10 feet (3 meters) long in the direction of travel, with 15 feet recommended for buildings exceeding 200 daily entries.
Anatomy of a 3-Zone 15-Foot Lobby Matting & Air Scrubbing System

Rather than buying a single custom 15-foot-long monolithic runner that weighs 45 pounds when soaked and cannot be lifted by a single night custodian without lower-back strain, experienced facility managers configure their 15-foot track-off corridor using modular 3x5-foot commercial mats paired with threshold disinfection and lobby HEPA air filtration:

items: Zone 1 (0 to 5 Feet — Exterior Threshold or Airlock Vestibule Scraper): The first 5 feet absorbs coarse gravel, mud clots, wet snow, and parking-lot sand. Installing an M+A Matting WaterHog Classic 3x5 Commercial Mat inside the vestibule airlock leverages its rigid bi-level polypropylene waffle ridges to scrape shoe lugs clean while its raised rubber water-dam border holds up to 1.5 gallons of water per square yard.

Zone 2 (5 to 10 Feet — Primary Interior Doorway Bi-Level Wiper/Scraper): Positioned immediately inside the interior vestibule door, a second M+A Matting WaterHog Classic 3x5 Commercial Mat (certified High-Traction by the National Floor Safety Institute, NFSI) catches the second set of left-and-right footsteps, shearing off emulsified moisture films that survived Zone 1.

Zone 3 (10 to 15 Feet — Final Drying & Fine Dust Wiper Zone): The final 5-foot section leading toward the reception desk or elevator bank dries the bottom of the shoe sole so employees do not hydroplane when stepping onto 1.04x VCT vinyl, 1.08x hardwood, or 1.12x ceramic tile.

Zone 4 (Airborne Dust & Touchpoint Sanitization Buffer): Every time a shoe hits a dry walk-off mat, fine 1-to-10-micron dust puffs upward into the lobby air. Staging a Medify MA-50 Commercial H13 HEPA Air Purifier (covering 1,100 sq ft at 2 ACH / 2,200 sq ft/hr), an Alen BreatheSmart 75i Commercial True HEPA Purifier (1,300 sq ft coverage with whisper-quiet operation and laser PM sensor), or a Winix 5500-2 True HEPA Purifier (360 sq ft for enclosed security vestibules) beside the walk-off runway captures aerosolized shoe dust in real time. Meanwhile, keeping CloroxPro Hydrogen Peroxide Cleaner Disinfectant Concentrate (128-oz gallon, 30-second to 1-minute contact time, zero harsh VOC fumes) in the janitor closet lets crews sanitize mop buckets, rubber mat borders, and entrance door hardware rapidly.

blocks.text: How the 5-Product Amazon Lobby Kit Works Together in Daily Operations

Buying three M+A Matting WaterHog Classic 3x5 Commercial Mats to form a continuous 3x15-foot modular runway solves three chronic operational headaches that plague rental laundry runners. First, rental laundry mats typically use light 12-to-16-ounce nylon pile on thin nitrile backings that curl at the corners and hydroplane across wet tile; the WaterHog Classic features crush-resistant bi-level polypropylene knuckles reinforced with rubber underneath so the waffle scraping cleats never flatten under wheeled delivery hand-trucks, plus an NFSI-certified slip-resistant backing and ADA-compliant beveled edges. Second, if a courier tracks roofing tar or spills coffee on the first 5 feet by the front door, your custodian only has to carry one manageable 3x5 section to the slop sink for hosing off while the remaining 10 feet stays on duty.

To keep the lobby environment healthy as hundreds of employees cross the 15-foot runway each morning, match your HEPA air purifier to your entrance architecture. If your 15-foot mat runway sits inside an enclosed 300-to-360-square-foot security vestibule or badge-turnstile corridor, install the Winix 5500-2 True HEPA Commercial Office Air Purifier, which uses a washable AOC activated carbon filter and True HEPA media to trap kicked-up shoe dust and vehicle exhaust pulled in through exterior doors. For main 1,000-to-1,300-square-foot reception lobbies, deploy the Medify MA-50 Commercial H13 HEPA Air Purifier (2,200 sq ft/hr rating, dual-side H13 intake, 36 dBA quiet speed) or the Alen BreatheSmart 75i Commercial True HEPA Purifier (1,300 sq ft medical-grade HEPA coverage with real-time laser dust sensing). Finally, stock the janitor closet with CloroxPro Hydrogen Peroxide Cleaner Disinfectant Concentrate (128-oz gallon). Because hydrogen peroxide breaks down into water and oxygen without leaving sticky quaternary ammonium residue or harsh bleach odors, custodians can dilute it into mop buckets and spray bottles to disinfect the non-porous rubber WaterHog borders, entrance push bars, and lobby tile with a rapid 30-second to 1-minute contact time.
5-Step Installation & Maintenance SOP for Your 15-Foot Matting Runway

A 15-foot matting system is only an asset as long as its fiber reservoir has room to hold new dirt. Once a walk-off mat becomes 100 percent saturated with sand, every subsequent shoe step tracks dirt *out* of the mat onto your interior floors. Require your janitorial team to follow this five-step SOP:

items.name: Align Three 3x5 WaterHog Mats Flush With Zero Overlapping Edges
items.text: Lay three M+A Matting WaterHog Classic 3x5 mats end-to-end along the natural 15-foot pedestrian path from the threshold toward reception. Butt the beveled rubber borders flush against one another—never overlap mat edges, which creates a 1/2-inch trip ridge that violates OSHA 1910.22.

items.name: Vacuum Zones 1, 2, and 3 With a Beater-Bar Upright in Two Directions
items.text: Every cleaning visit (whether 3x/week at 13.0 visits/month or 5x/week at 21.65 visits/month), vacuum the 15-foot runway both lengthwise and crosswise across the bi-level waffle pattern to lift trapped sand out of the lower water-dam troughs.

items.name: Rotate Zone 1 and Zone 3 Mats Every Friday Night
items.text: Zone 1 (0 to 5 feet) absorbs 55 percent of total wear and grit, while Zone 3 (10 to 15 feet) absorbs 15 percent. Because you constructed the 15-foot runway from three identical 3x5 WaterHog Classic mats, swap Zone 1 and Zone 3 weekly to triple the service life of the set.

items.name: Sanitize Rubber Borders and Threshold Touchpoints With CloroxPro H2O2
items.text: Dilute CloroxPro Hydrogen Peroxide Cleaner Disinfectant Concentrate per label instructions and wipe down door push-plates, badge readers, and the surrounding tile perimeter, observing the 30-second to 1-minute wet contact dwell time.

items.name: Hose or Wet-Extract Saturated Mats Monthly and Dry Flat
items.text: Once a month (or weekly during winter snowstorms), extract the polypropylene face or hose it down at the loading dock, tilt on edge to drain the rubber water-dam border, and verify both the mat backing and lobby floor are dry before resetting.

faqs.q: Why is buying three 3x5 mats better than ordering one single 3x15-foot roll runner for an office lobby?
faqs.a: While a single 3x15-foot runner works well in wide loading docks, three modular 3x5 M+A Matting WaterHog Classic mats offer three major operational advantages in a Class A office lobby: (1) each 3x5 mat has a four-sided perimeter rubber water dam that compartmentalizes melted snow in Zone 1 rather than letting water wick all 15 feet down the runner; (2) a single custodian can lift and carry one wet 3x5 mat without violating ergonomic lifting limits; and (3) you can rotate the high-wear Zone 1 threshold mat with the low-wear Zone 3 interior mat every week to double total replacement lifespan.

faqs.q: Why does NFSI High-Traction certification matter for our building's General Liability COI and slip-and-fall risk?
faqs.a: Slip-and-fall claims in wet entrance lobbies are the single largest premises liability exposure for commercial property owners and janitorial contractors. The National Floor Safety Institute (NFSI) tests floor mats and coatings under ANSI/NFSI B101.1 wet static coefficient of friction standards. Specifying NFSI-certified mats like the M+A Matting WaterHog Classic 3x5 across a full 15-foot track-off distance documents proactive duty-of-care compliance for both your facility casualty insurer and your janitorial vendor's Certificate of Insurance (COI) loss-control auditor.

faqs.q: Can we use CloroxPro Hydrogen Peroxide Cleaner Disinfectant Concentrate on carpet runners or only on hard surfaces?
faqs.a: CloroxPro Hydrogen Peroxide Cleaner Disinfectant Concentrate is an EPA-registered hard-surface disinfectant engineered for non-porous floors, ceramic tile, VCT, glass, stainless door hardware, and the solid rubber borders of entrance mats (achieving 30-second to 1-minute bactericidal and virucidal contact times without harsh fumes). While diluted hydrogen peroxide chemistry is widely used as a color-safe stain oxidizer on solution-dyed polypropylene mat fibers like the WaterHog Classic (which is fade- and bleach-resistant polypropylene), EPA hard-surface disinfection claims apply specifically to non-porous surfaces.

faqs.q: How does our cleaning frequency (1x, 2x, 3x, or 5x per week) change the mat vacuuming workload in our janitorial contract?
faqs.a: Using the standard 4.33 weeks per month billing factor, a 1x-week office receives 4.33 visits/month (1.08x rate multiplier), 2x-week receives 8.66 visits/month (1.00x multiplier), 3x-week receives 13.0 visits/month (0.95x multiplier), and 5x-week receives 21.65 visits/month (0.90x multiplier). If your office has more than 75 daily occupants or visitors but is only cleaned 1x or 2x per week, a single 3x5 mat will saturate with grit by Tuesday afternoon. Expanding to a 15-foot (45-square-foot) bi-level mat reservoir provides 300% more soil storage capacity between custodial vacuuming visits.

faqs.q: Where should the Medify MA-50 or Alen BreatheSmart 75i HEPA air purifier be plugged in relative to the 15-foot walk-off mat?
faqs.a: Position the HEPA air purifier 6 to 10 feet inside the interior lobby door, parallel to Zone 2 or Zone 3 of the matting runway and at least 18 inches clear of walls or reception furniture. This placement intercepts both outdoor vehicle exhaust/pollen pulled in when the entrance doors swing open and fine 2.5-micron shoe dust kicked upward as visitors walk across the dry wiper section of the mat runway.
